programs.purpose: Batch subroutine for file I/O operations (open/close/read) on TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, CUSTFILE, ACCTFILE — called by statement report program
risks: Called via LINKAGE SECTION — must preserve calling convention in target platform
GOBACK semantics differ between batch and CICS
programs.gnucobol_notes: Straightforward batch subroutine. LINKAGE SECTION and GOBACK are fully supported in GnuCOBOL. File I/O with indexed/sequential access works natively.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a shared FileAccessService class with methods for each file operation (open, close, read, readByKey). Use Spring Data or JDBC for file-to-DB mapping.

programs.purpose: Batch program to generate account statements in plain text and HTML from transaction data, with PSA/TCB/TIOT control block inspection and ALTER/GO TO flow
risks: Uses ALTER and GO TO for dynamic control flow — extremely hard to convert
PSA/TCB/TIOT mainframe control block addressing via POINTER — z/OS specific
COMP and COMP-3 variables with 2D arrays
Tightly coupled to CBSTM03B subroutine
programs.gnucobol_notes: CRITICAL: PSA/TCB/TIOT block addressing (SET ADDRESS OF) is z/OS-specific and will NOT compile. Must be stubbed or removed. ALTER statement is deprecated and not portable. COMP-3 works in GnuCOBOL but test thoroughly.
programs.java_notes: Most complex batch program. Refactor the ALTER/GO TO spaghetti into a clean state machine or strategy pattern. Replace control block inspection with environment queries. The HTML generation is a good candidate for a template engine (Thymeleaf/FreeMarker).

programs.purpose: Batch program to read and print the card cross-reference (XREF) data file
risks: CEE3ABD is an IBM LE runtime call for abnormal termination
programs.gnucobol_notes: Simple read-and-display program. Replace CEE3ABD with STOP RUN or a GnuCOBOL-compatible error handler.
programs.java_notes: Trivial conversion to a Spring Batch reader/writer or simple main() method that reads a DB table and logs output.

programs.purpose: Batch program to read and print the card data file
risks: CEE3ABD IBM LE call
programs.gnucobol_notes: Simple sequential read. Direct port to GnuCOBOL with CEE3ABD replacement.
programs.java_notes: Trivial conversion — simple file/DB dump utility.

programs.purpose: Batch program to read accounts and write to multiple output files (flat, array, variable-length record formats) with date formatting
risks: Calls assembler program COBDATFT for date formatting
Variable-length record (RECORDING MODE V) handling
COMP-3 usage in output records
OCCURS clause with COMP-3 nested fields
programs.gnucobol_notes: RECORDING MODE V is supported but test variable-length record handling carefully. COBDATFT assembler call must be replaced with a COBOL or C equivalent.
programs.java_notes: Replace with Spring Batch ItemReader/ItemWriter. Date formatting via java.time. Multiple output files map to multiple ItemWriters or a CompositeItemWriter.

programs.purpose: Batch interest calculator — reads transaction category balances, looks up disclosure group rates, computes monthly interest, and updates account records
risks: Complex business logic for interest calculation
Multiple file cross-references
ALTERNATE RECORD KEY on XREF file
PARM-DATE received via LINKAGE from JCL
programs.gnucobol_notes: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY is supported in GnuCOBOL. PROCEDURE DIVISION USING EXTERNAL-PARMS works. The 1400-COMPUTE-FEES is stubbed ('To be implemented').
programs.java_notes: Core business logic — convert to an InterestCalculationService with clear separation of rate lookup, computation, and account update. Consider a domain-driven design approach. The unimplemented fees section is a TODO.

programs.purpose: Batch program to read and print the customer data file
risks: CEE3ABD IBM LE call
programs.gnucobol_notes: Simple file dump. Direct port.
programs.java_notes: Trivial conversion — simple customer file/DB dump utility.

programs.purpose: Batch program to read daily transactions, validate card numbers via XREF lookup, and verify account records
risks: Opens 6 files simultaneously
Validation-only — no actual posting
programs.gnucobol_notes: Standard batch file I/O. All INDEXED/RANDOM access patterns are supported.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a Spring Batch validation step. Card/account lookup becomes JPA repository calls.

programs.purpose: Batch program to post daily transactions — validates, writes to transaction file, updates account balances, maintains transaction category balances, and writes rejects
risks: Core transaction posting logic — high business criticality
6 files open simultaneously with mixed I-O/INPUT/OUTPUT modes
Creates/rewrites TCATBAL records (upsert pattern)
DB2 timestamp formatting logic
programs.gnucobol_notes: I-O mode for REWRITE is supported. The RETURN-CODE special register usage should work in GnuCOBOL. Test the TCATBAL create-or-update logic carefully.
programs.java_notes: Critical batch job — convert to Spring Batch with chunk-based processing. The validation/posting/rejection flow maps to an ItemProcessor with ItemWriter delegation. Transaction category balance management needs careful DB transaction handling.

programs.purpose: Batch program to generate a detailed transaction report with page/account/grand totals, date range filtering, and reference data lookups
risks: NEXT SENTENCE usage (archaic, different from CONTINUE)
Report pagination logic
6 files open simultaneously
programs.gnucobol_notes: NEXT SENTENCE is supported but behaves differently from CONTINUE — verify control flow. Report file writing is straightforward.
programs.java_notes: Convert to Spring Batch report generation. Use JasperReports or custom report builder. Date range parameters become command-line args or job parameters.

programs.purpose: Batch program to import customer data from branch migration export file — splits multi-record types into separate normalized output files with validation and statistics
risks: 7 files open simultaneously
RECORDING MODE IS F specification
Import statistics and error handling
programs.gnucobol_notes: Standard batch file splitting. RECORDING MODE IS F is a z/OS extension — remove or replace with standard FD. All file I/O patterns are supported.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a Spring Batch multi-format file reader with classifier-based routing to different writers. Error handling maps to skip/retry policies.

programs.purpose: Batch program to export customer data for branch migration — reads all CardDemo files and creates multi-record export file with statistics
risks: 6 input files + 1 output file open simultaneously
ACCEPT ... FROM DATE YYYYMMDD and FROM TIME syntax
RECORDING MODE IS F
programs.gnucobol_notes: ACCEPT FROM DATE YYYYMMDD is supported in GnuCOBOL. RECORDING MODE IS F should be removed. File key references (CUST-ID, ACCT-ID etc.) come from COPYbooks in FD section — verify they resolve correctly.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a Spring Batch export job with CompositeItemReader reading from multiple tables and a single ItemWriter producing the export format.

programs.purpose: Tiny batch utility to pause execution for a specified time in centiseconds via MVSWAIT
risks: MVSWAIT is an IBM-specific wait service
programs.gnucobol_notes: Replace MVSWAIT CALL with a COBOL ACCEPT/DISPLAY timer or C interop for sleep().
programs.java_notes: Replace with Thread.sleep() — trivial.

programs.purpose: Shared date validation utility — calls CEEDAYS (IBM LE) to validate dates and returns descriptive error codes
risks: CEEDAYS is IBM Language Environment specific
Feedback code uses hex literal 88-level checks
Called by COTRN02C and CORPT00C
programs.gnucobol_notes: CEEDAYS must be replaced. GnuCOBOL has no built-in equivalent. Write a replacement using FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE or a C-interop wrapper.
programs.java_notes: Replace with java.time.LocalDate.parse() with DateTimeFormatter. Return validation result as a simple response object.

programs.purpose: CICS sign-on screen — authenticates users against USRSEC file and routes to admin menu (COADM01C) or regular menu (COMEN01C)
risks: Entry point for the entire application
Password comparison in plain text
FUNCTION UPPER-CASE usage
programs.gnucobol_notes: CICS commands not supported — requires complete rewrite for non-CICS environment. All EXEC CICS blocks must be replaced.
programs.java_notes: Convert to Spring Security authentication controller. User lookup becomes a UserDetailsService implementation. The admin/regular routing becomes role-based access control.

programs.purpose: CICS main menu for regular users — displays menu options and routes to selected feature programs via XCTL
risks: Dynamic XCTL based on menu option table — must map all target programs
INQUIRE PROGRAM is CICS-specific to check program availability
Central routing hub — many programs depend on this
programs.gnucobol_notes: Not portable to GnuCOBOL due to heavy CICS dependency. Requires full rewrite.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a Spring MVC controller with menu template. Dynamic routing becomes @RequestMapping methods. Menu configuration from COMEN02Y copybook becomes application properties.

programs.purpose: CICS admin menu for admin users — displays admin options and routes to user management programs
risks: HANDLE CONDITION PGMIDERR — CICS-specific error handling
Dynamic XCTL from admin option table
programs.gnucobol_notes: Not portable due to CICS dependency.
programs.java_notes: Convert to admin dashboard controller. Menu options from COADM02Y become admin-specific endpoints.

programs.purpose: CICS program to list transactions from TRANSACT file with paginated browse (PF7/PF8) and selection for detail view
risks: Forward/backward pagination via STARTBR/READNEXT/READPREV/ENDBR — complex browse pattern
10-row list display with repetitive EVALUATE blocks
Selection routing to COTRN01C via XCTL
programs.gnucobol_notes: Heavy CICS browse commands not portable. Requires full rewrite.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a paginated REST API with Spring Data JPA Pageable. The 10-row screen maps to page size. Selection becomes a detail link/endpoint.

programs.purpose: CICS program to view a single transaction detail from TRANSACT file with field display
risks: READ with UPDATE option — acquires lock even for view-only
Navigation back to COTRN00C or COMEN01C
programs.gnucobol_notes: CICS READ with DATASET not portable.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a transaction detail REST endpoint. The READ UPDATE should become a simple SELECT (no locking needed for view).

programs.purpose: CICS program to add a new transaction — validates input fields, calls CSUTLDTC for date validation, writes to TRANSACT file, and updates account balance
risks: Cross-file transaction: writes TRANSACT + updates ACCTDAT — no CICS SYNCPOINT
Calls CSUTLDTC for date validation
ASKTIME/FORMATTIME for timestamps
Auto-generates transaction ID by reading last ID and incrementing
programs.gnucobol_notes: Not portable due to heavy CICS usage including ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, and multiple file operations.
programs.java_notes: Convert to a transactional service method with @Transactional. Date validation via java.time. Timestamp generation via Instant.now(). Transaction ID generation needs a sequence or UUID strategy.

programs.purpose: CICS program to view account details — reads card XREF, account master, and customer master files to display a consolidated account view
risks: Reads 3 different files (xref, account, customer) to compose view
HANDLE ABEND with label — non-structured error handling
STRING for SSN formatting
Copies CSSTRPFY for PF key storage
programs.gnucobol_notes: Not portable due to CICS dependency. Very large working storage with many copybooks.
programs.java_notes: Convert to an AccountViewController with three JPA repository calls. SSN formatting becomes a display utility. The composite data gathering maps to a service aggregation pattern.

programs.purpose: CICS program to update account details — extensive field-level validation, date validation via CSUTLDTC, reads/rewrites account and customer records
risks: LARGEST program in the codebase (4236 lines)
Extremely detailed field-level input validation (phone, date, state, zip, SSN, numeric, alpha, yes/no)
Multiple REWRITE operations across ACCTDAT and CUSTDAT without SYNCPOINT
Calls CSUTLDTC for date validation
INSPECT CONVERTING for case conversion
programs.gnucobol_notes: Not portable. The sheer size and CICS dependency make this the hardest single program to migrate.
programs.java_notes: Break into multiple classes: AccountUpdateController, AccountUpdateValidator, AccountUpdateService. Use Bean Validation (JSR-380) for field validation. Spring @Transactional for multi-file updates.

programs.purpose: CICS program to view credit card details — accepts account/card search criteria and displays card information

Shared page with COCRDLIC for navigation

Business-critical payment processing

programs.java_notes: Replace JCL submission with a Spring Batch job launcher. Report parameters become job parameters. The TDQ write becomes a REST call to trigger the batch job. Consider using Spring Cloud Task.
